definitions.explanation: A fight, race or rivalry among three sides, each against both others. From the design of three comma shapes chasing each other in a circle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三|み}つどもえになった。
examples.english: The election became a three-way race.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三|み}つどもえだ。
examples.english: The race for the title is between three teams.

examples.japanese: {三社|さんしゃ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{三|み}つどもえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行方|ゆくえ}→行方：04082_yukue⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The three-way battle among the three companies continues, and where the market is heading is still unclear.

notes:
Also written {三|み}つ{巴|どもえ}. The {巴|ともえ} is a comma-shaped figure; three of them swirling in a circle form a common family crest and the pattern on many taiko drums.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三|み}つどもえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ / ⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧: a three-way fight
- {三|み}つどもえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙戦|せんきょせん}→選挙戦：31622_senkyosen⟧: a three-way election race
- {三|み}つどもえ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a three-way contest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一騎打|いっきう}ち→一騎打ち：11186_ikkiuchi⟧: a one-on-one contest between two sides
